title: The Missing Parish Anew
author: Edmund Thackeray
blurb: Ivo Montrose, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
